purpose: K-v2 honest-latency anytime W and core-speed sweep; frozen before reporting; exploration only

compute.avoid_cache_affinity: 48-63 and 112-127; no changes to caches or X

decision_rules.ci: pointwise paired percentile 95%, 5000 shared seed resamples; no adjustment
decision_rules.slope: piecewise differences in loss pp per 40ms reduction; paired CI plus least-squares slope on 120/160/200
decision_rules.minimum_speed: smallest measured deadline/200 passing upper paired CI <= -10pp; linear interpolated point crossing reported separately, never extrapolate; effective scoring ratio (D-8)/192 disclosed

ordering.complete_score: 3 styles at horizon160; no partial or late root eligible
ordering.K4h: h80 used only for ranking; all 3 styles recomputed at160 for refinement
ordering.deadline: full pipeline starts before observation; scoring cutoff = start + deadline - 8ms; no drain, 8ms reserve; OS scheduling residuals measured honestly
ordering.threading: four persistent private-root GIL-release workers; timed collector returns at cutoff without draining; native per-rollout shared remaining budget hard-stops each next tick; cancelled event blocks further style/task starts

lateness.play: reserve at decision tick, command due=decision tick+27+overrun_ticks
lateness.wait: wait interval starts at decision tick+overrun_ticks; own poll channel unavailable until then
lateness.opponent: v1 has no search deadline; unchanged cadence
lateness.emulation: deadline sweep preserves 8ms reserve and real-time delay ticks; budget equivalence only, not hardware underclocking
